subject.title: fix(agent): recover disconnected gateway runs before rerunning

question: When a disconnected accepted Gateway run cannot be proven terminal after wait and cache-only replay, should `openclaw agent` retain the current automatic isolated embedded fallback or fail closed unless the user explicitly opts into rerun?
rationale: Both choices are user-visible compatibility policy: automatic rerun can duplicate effects, while fail-closed behavior can leave an interactive invocation without a result and changes the current fallback contract.

options.title: Retain recovery-then-fallback
options.body: Keep recovery as a best-effort preflight and retain the current isolated automatic fallback after recovery exhaustion, with clear diagnostics.

options.title: Fail closed by default
options.body: Stop after an unknown outcome and require an explicit rerun opt-in, updating CLI help, docs, and fresh-install and upgrade evidence.

options.title: Split behavior by delivery mode
options.body: Use different ambiguity behavior for `--deliver` and interactive stdout only if maintainers want to own the added policy complexity.

recommendation.title: Retain recovery-then-fallback
recommendation.body: Keep recovery as a best-effort preflight and retain the current isolated automatic fallback after recovery exhaustion, with clear diagnostics.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the current fresh-session fallback behavior whose compatibility contract is being reconsidered.
